chosen.premise: Oddish grows by moonlight, yet its evolution can branch into Bellossom using a Sun Stone.
chosen.hook: The moon-grown Pokémon can evolve with a Sun Stone.
chosen.visualIdea: Contrast moonlight bathing Oddish with Gloom evolving into Bellossom under a glowing Sun Stone.
chosen.note: A crisp, surprising contradiction: Oddish grows through moonlight but can ultimately branch into Bellossom through a Sun Stone. The evolution and Pokédex facts directly support it.

candidates.premise: At night, Oddish can walk nearly 1,000 feet using its two roots.
candidates.hook: Those two roots can carry Oddish nearly 1,000 feet.
candidates.visualIdea: Animate root-like feet marching across a distance meter that climbs toward 1,000 feet.
candidates.note: Exceptionally concrete and distinctive. The 1,000-foot claim is compelling, though the entry frames it as something Oddish is only said to do.

candidates.premise: Oddish looks like a clump of weeds, but pulling it from the ground makes it shriek horribly.
candidates.hook: That harmless-looking weed screams if you try to pull it.
candidates.visualIdea: Zoom in on a normal-looking weed clump, then yank it and cut to Oddish screaming.
candidates.note: A highly visual horror-comedy premise backed by a direct Pokédex entry, though it has less built-in escalation than the strongest contradiction.

candidates.premise: While planted during the day, Oddish’s feet are thought to change shape into something like tree roots.
candidates.hook: Oddish may literally grow tree roots instead of feet.
candidates.visualIdea: Show Oddish’s feet morphing from rounded feet into branching roots beneath fertile soil.
candidates.note: Visually striking and very Pokémon-specific, but the source says the root transformation is only thought to happen, so the hook slightly overstates the evidence.

candidates.premise: Oddish buries itself by day but becomes an active seed-sower after moonlight awakens it at night.
candidates.hook: Oddish has two completely different lives, depending on the sky.
candidates.visualIdea: Split-screen day and night: buried Oddish by day, roaming Oddish scattering seeds at night.
candidates.note: Strongly supported and easy to visualize, but the day/night contrast is a familiar Oddish fact and less surprising to longtime fans.

rounds.request: None—the selected angle is strong enough. A stronger alternative would need an equally specific contradiction or measurable fact with direct Pokédex support and a clear visual payoff.
